subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.11 published dist missing reentrancy guard - reply session initialization conflicted

question: Should maintainers publish a stable package containing the current reply-session/store-writer fixes before closing this package-parity issue?
rationale: The source-side fixes are on main, but the user-facing stable install path still points at a tarball that lacks the runtime fix; choosing hotfix timing versus waiting for the next stable train is a release-owner decision.

options.title: Publish stable package
options.body: Ship a stable package whose dist passes tarball parity checks for `reentrant` writer support and reply-init metadata drift before closing this issue.

options.title: Defer to next stable train
options.body: Keep this issue open and clearly treat `2026.6.11` stable as affected until a later stable release is published and validated.

recommendation.title: Publish stable package
